biotools.summary: MitoChontrol is a cell-type-aware probabilistic framework for single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) quality control. It models mitochondrial transcript content using a Gaussian mixture distribution to selectively filter compromised cells while retaining viable populations.
